verdict.rationale: telli is an AI voice platform, so a training opt-out is a fair question for it. The evidence pack has no documented control that stops customer or call data from being used to train AI models. Automatic data retention deletion and consent-conditional recording are adjacent privacy controls, not a training opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
